ledger_reader.doc: The ledger page (LedgerReader, M5-A3P-1706; act3_ch17 B05 'The ledger', held page-turns and a blank-page end). Rects x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference, multiples of 3. The page sits above the subtitles: a Panel at `page` with `pad` inside, the record's name (title_key) in its head, then each entry the scene writes, top to bottom, line_gap apart, in the reader's hand (entry_variation). A line is written on the page when its line id starts with `line_prefix` (the scene's #narration entries; they still caption below). The page turns when a held gate opened with `turn_prompt` closes (CutsceneHoldGate's hold_input / hold_input_end): the written page slides `turn_px` left and fades over turn_sec, and the next comes up blank. After the last entry there is nothing more to write, so every page after it stays blank (ADR 0022 sweep-J). The page fades in at its first entry or turn and out over fade_sec when the scene ends. canvas_layer: above the field, under the dialogue box.
